dc_title: Characterization of mercury species in brown and white rice (Oryza sativa L.) grown in water-saving paddies
dc_author: Sarah E. Rothenberg, Xinbin Feng, Bin Dong, Lihai Shang, Runsheng Yin, Xiaobo Yuan
dc_subject: Methylmercury, Milled white rice, Translocation, Water-saving paddies
dcterms_abstract: 在中国三个采用节水种植方法的稻田和一个汞污染淹水种植的稻田中，量化了稻米中的总汞和甲基汞含量。研究发现，抛光白米中的总汞和甲基汞浓度与根际土壤中的汞含量呈正相关，表明稻米中的汞部分来源于土壤，且从土壤到稻米的转运与灌溉方式和汞水平无关，尽管其他因素可能也很重要。未碾磨的糙米中总汞和其他微量元素含量显著较高，而甲基汞含量则有所不同。甲基汞比无机汞更有效地转运到胚乳中。
institution: State Key Laboratory of Environmental Geochemistry, Institute of Geochemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences; State Key Laboratory of Water Resources and Hydropower Engineering Science, Wuhan University; College of Resources and the Environment, Southwest University
